title: Membership in a coordinate subcube
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $C$ be a set of coordinates in $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$, and let $b,x$ be points of the $n$-coordinate binary cube. Then $x$ belongs to the coordinate subcube determined by $C$ and $b$ if and only if $x_i=b_i$ for every $i\in C$.
hypotheses_covered: $C$ is a finite set of coordinates among the $n$ coordinates
$b$ and $x$ are points of the binary cube
